title: G7 companion readings not reaching AndroidAPS
symptom: Fresh G7 transmitter and AndroidAPS shows no glucose values while the G7 app reads fine.
cause: Companion mode stopped pushing after the G7 app was restarted following the sensor start.
fix: Priya Nair fixed it by opening the G7 app once, waiting for readings, then checking the G7 tab in AndroidAPS.
evidence_quote: Open the G7 app once, wait for readings, then check AndroidAPS receives them on the G7 tab.
